GAGANDEEP DHONDI Platforms

Product Manager / Owner | Payments | Reconciliation | Fintech

81veritas@gmail.com | 9866656020| LinkedIn | Pune-MH

PROFILE SUMMARY Experienced Product Management professional with 14+ yrs dedicated to building scalable payments, reconciliation, Reporting and fintech platforms across B2B2C and SaaS ecosystems and Digital transformations. and 7 yrs in Back Office Ops was part of Capital Markets, Account maintenance and Investment banking. Passionate about understanding customer pain points and identifying business opportunities to meet their needs, for digital transformation, and business innovation.

Expertise in Payments (Card, ACH, billing, autopay), B2B SAAS solutions for Fintech Reconciliation & Confirmations and Settlement systems Custody FX & Program trading and capital markets platforms, Regulatory, Governance, compliance, and reporting solutions Strong track record of driving end-to-end product delivery, improving transaction success rates, reducing processing costs, and enabling scalable financial systems.

CORE SKILLS Product Discovery, Strategy & Roadmapping Reconciliation & Settlement / Confirmation Systems Agile (Scrum, Kanban); Safe Data-driven decision making (SQL, Power BI) Governance, Compliance and Legal Management Pre prep & POC work and presentations

Payments (Card, ACH, Billing, UPI-like flows) API & Platform Products Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership Market research and Campaign management Adaptable Using AI and Agentic AI tools

TECHNICAL SKILLS Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Kanban | Project Management | Confluence | JIRA | Tools: Miro, Visio, PPT, Figma, Draw.IO | Product Roadmap | Fintech | Card & ACH | Product LRP/ AOP | Webservices, API, Postman, Splunk | Stakeholder Management | BRD & FRD | Communication MGMT | Qlik View | Power BI | MSSQL | MS Office | Trading Tools: GTSS, FXAll, MYSIS, Omgeo, CLS, TLM, TICS | SWIFT – ISO 8583 & 20022 | MT’s | Custody FX | Program Trading | FXALL | GTSS | OMGEO | MYSIS | Advent Axis | eDealer | Using AI and Agentic AI

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE SR PRODUCT MANAGER - TPO | Experis IT Pvt Ltd. - BNY | Pune, MH Product Ownership & Strategy - Custody FX and Program Trading Business – BNY – Mobile & Web Own end-to-end delivery of product enhancements, features, and functional improvements from discovery through launch. Collaborate with Product Manager and key stakeholders to shape product discovery, vision, roadmap, and prioritize aligned to business objectives and GTM documentation. Translate discussions, stakeholder input, & data insights into actionable product initiatives delivering measurable customer & business value. Contribute to roadmap planning by identifying opportunities, assessing trade-offs, and aligning initiatives with strategic goals. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture and Operations teams to drive product initiatives in fast-paced, Agile environment. Lead cross-functional discussions to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and ensure alignment on scope and timelines. Balance stakeholder priorities while maintaining focus on delivering maximum customer value. Product Development & Agile Execution Breaking down roadmap initiatives into well-defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Own, prioritize, continuously refine backlog by business and customer needs & performance data, ensuring efficient execution and deliver. Identify risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, proactively driving mitigation plans. Ensure compliance with organizational governance processes and required documentation for production releases. User Experience & Customer Focus

July 2025 - Present

Collaborate with Design and User Research teams to define intuitive and scalable user experiences. Incorporate customer feedback and usability insights into product iterations. Define support, monitoring, and post-launch feedback loops to ensure product stability and customer satisfaction. Performance & Continuous Improvement Track and analyse product performance post-launch using defined KPIs. Use insights to inform iteration, optimization, and future investment decisions. Contribute to the evolution of product practices by participating in and strengthening the Product Owner Centre of Excellence.

PRODUCT MANAGER - ADVISOR | Fiserv Global Services | Pune, MH Aug 2018 - June 2025 Worked on Payments (Card / ACH - Immediate, One-time future dated, Recurring and Autopay) Mobile & Web and Reconciliation product Participated in defining and discussion for product roadmap for Payments/Billing and Recon product supporting business goals Collaborated with cross-functional teams to drive product development from ideation, discovery to launch, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to quality standards. Translated intricate business requirements into detailed Epics, Features, User stories, and product specifications, facilitating clear communication and alignment across stakeholders. Managed & prioritized product backlog, continuously refined & groomed requirements with teams delivering roadmap items. Product Documentation, Release documentation and Client Communications using Poppulo tool Increased the number of successful transactions by reducing the failures count. Worked on reducing processing cost of the transactions for implementation of the Surcharge as per the industry standards. Improved the consumer journey helping the gain in the new clients and consumers.
